# TibetRide — Small Group Tibet Tours with Local Experts

## About
TibetRide (tibetride.com) provides small-group Tibet tours led by native Tibetan guides since 2016. We handle all permits (Tibet Travel Permit, Alien's Travel Permit, military area passes) so travelers don't have to. Group size maximum 8 people. Bilingual (Chinese/English) service. All tours include oxygen and emergency protocols.
